Procedures for the industrious start
This part of the manual describes the plain rules

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: This section sets the day-to-day rules for handling companion animals at Aurelia Skyways with steady records, clear handoffs, and fast support.

Staff must check carrier condition, ticket match, and health papers before any animal moves toward the gate. The welcome team prepares passengers for boarding and the records aide logs any concern without delay. If a traveler is unsettled, the desk gives calm instruction, confirms the booking, and keeps the line moving. Do not separate a pet from its owner unless safety, screening, or crew direction requires it. Keep water, relief access, and ventilation under watch, and report any refusal to board at once. <<FACT F012>> Use the note field for handling remarks, but do not guess at missing facts. The department shares practical instructions with crews, and the supervisor must hear anything that may affect the journey. When a pet shows stress, the staff member on duty should slow the process, speak plainly, and ask for the senior coordinator if the issue stays open.

For relief access, use the approved route only, keep the area clean, and secure the gate after use. <<FACT F017>> Never share access details with passengers or outside staff, and never write them on visible slips. If an animal is injured, missing, or left without a responsible traveler, treat the record as urgent and notify the control desk immediately. Each journey is a shared responsibility, and every note must be complete, legible, and filed without delay.

Contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk for unresolved concerns.
